OPERATION SPECIALIST

Binance · Permanent

Mar 2024 - Present · 2 yrs 8 mos

Present

Drove the Binance Wallet from under 5% market share to #1 in 2 months, hitting $5B+ daily trading volume (95% dominance) and 670% growth in active users (159k addresses). 

Grew social media followers by 47% to 3M and community members by 280% to 74k through campaigns tailored for global audiences (including Southeast Asia). Built a Web3-focused KOL network that generated 25M+ campaign views without a dedicated budget, while addressing 4,800+ user feedback submissions to refine product workflows. 

Crisis Management: Handled 45+ high-stakes PR incidentsProduct Collaboration: Partnered with engineering teams to launch Binance Live/Audio Live, boosting live streamers by 500%+. 

Led the 0-1 launch and scaling of social platforms, hitting 6M daily active users (+43% vs. baseline) and 22M monthly actives. Recruited 5,000+ KOLs (3,000 with 100k+ followers), including top EU/MENA/SEA creators, driving a 58% transaction conversion rate. 

Data & Campaign Execution: Cut complaints by 350% monthly through data analysis and SOP refinements. Organized viral campaigns like Token2049 events and trading contests, resulting in 25M+ engagements and stronger project partnerships.
… more

selection.rationale: 保存的职业资料显示其目前在 Binance 任职，个人简介为 Marketing Specialist，职责包含全球营销活动、社交媒体及社区增长，符合目标公司的 Marketing 人员条件。本判断依据已保存的职业证据，无须额外帖子或语言证据。
